routing_guidelines.description: Complaint-routing rules for Harborline Mutual, a fictional property & casualty carrier. Illustrative sample data only.

urgency_levels.critical: Contact the customer within 2 business hours. A supervisor owns the response.
urgency_levels.high: Respond within 1 business day. Supervisor reviews the response before it is sent.
urgency_levels.standard: Respond within 3 business days. Handled by the assigned claims or service representative.
urgency_levels.low: Respond within 7 business days. Standard handling.

supervisor_escalation.requested_supervisor: Customer asks for a supervisor, manager, or other senior contact
supervisor_escalation.legal_threat: Customer threatens legal action or mentions involving an attorney
supervisor_escalation.regulator_threat: Customer threatens a complaint to a regulator or consumer agency (state insurance department, CFPB, BBB)
supervisor_escalation.cancellation: Customer intends to cancel, switch carriers, or has already cancelled
supervisor_escalation.eo_exposure: Facts suggest possible errors & omissions exposure (coverage misrepresented or never explained)
supervisor_escalation.public_threat: Customer threatens to go public (news media, social media, review sites)

legal_review.attorney_involved: Customer has retained or is consulting an attorney
legal_review.litigation: Complaint mentions a lawsuit, litigation, or suing

regulatory_flag.regulator_complaint: Customer states they will file, or have filed, a complaint with the state insurance regulator
regulatory_flag.vulnerable_customer: Complaint involves a potentially vulnerable customer (elderly, disability, recent bereavement)
regulatory_flag.repeat_complaint: Repeat complaint from the same customer within {repeat_complaint_window_days} days

response_tone_guidelines.hostile_or_angry: Lead with a specific acknowledgement of what went wrong for them. Stay calm and non-defensive; no policy citations in the first paragraph. Name who will contact them and by when.
response_tone_guidelines.upset_or_frustrated: Show you understand by restating their concern in your own words, then explain what happens next and give a clear path to resolution.
response_tone_guidelines.concerned_or_calm: Be clear, courteous, and factual. Answer the question asked and list any next steps.
